criticisms: The executive summary is slightly long at 3 sentences but is within acceptable range; no material deficiency.
The 'Top Signals' section header does not use the conventional label 'Key Signals' but is functionally equivalent and clearly identifiable.

The Data Caveats section is substantive but could benefit from noting that the 30-event sample represents only 20% of the 150-event catalog, which limits statistical inference — though the report does gesture at this limitation.
No structural deficiencies that would prevent publication; all five required sections are present and substantive.
